Body.Content:
What and why

The September 2026 Windows security update will be released as a standard update rather than a hotpatch update. Some of the security improvements in this update change components that cannot be updated without a restart. As a result, devices enrolled in hotpatching will need to restart to complete installation.

Rollout schedule

  • September 2026: Standard update with restart required for all devices including those that are hotpatch-enabled.
  • October 2026: Planned baseline update month with restart required.
  • November 2026: Next hotpatch update expected.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Organizations using Windows Autopatch with hotpatch-enabled devices
  • Users of devices currently enrolled in hotpatch updates

Platforms and services

  • Windows Autopatch
  • Windows 11 hotpatch
  • Windows Server hotpatch

What will happen

  • Hotpatch-enabled devices will require a restart to complete installation of the September 2026 security update.
  • Hotpatch-enabled devices will remain enrolled in hotpatch updates.
  • Devices not using hotpatch updates are unaffected because standard Windows security updates already require a restart.
  • No changes are being made to hotpatch enrollment or configuration requirements.

Action required / recommendations

No action is required.

We recommend that administrators:

  • Inform affected users that a restart will be required following installation of the September 2026 security update.
  • Review maintenance windows and device restart policies to help ensure timely installation.
  • Continue monitoring update deployment and compliance through existing management tools.
  • Track the hotpatch update calendars on the Windows release health site for both Windows 11 and Windows Server. 

Learn more

  • Windows 11 hotpatch calendar - Windows 11 release information | Release health | Windows | Microsoft Learn
  • Windows Server hotpatch calendar - Windows Server release information | Windows Search release information | Windows | Microsoft Learn

Compliance considerations

No compliance action is required. Update installation and restart behavior will be reflected in update history and compliance reports as usual.

Title: Microsoft Windows Autopatch: September 2026 Windows security update requires a restart for hotpatch-enabled devices
